statement: Boundary files in this submission inherit repository provisional geometry and are not official redlines.
risk: Area, frontage, and parcel quantities may change after official CAD/GIS replacement.
mitigation: All affected metrics are tagged provisional and self_check includes a warning.

statement: Regulatory FAR, height, land-use, municipal capacity and property constraints are not publicly available in the checked package.
risk: Project lists require later calibration to statutory planning controls.
mitigation: Use a no-net-loss public-space principle and keep development metrics as planning targets, not approvals.

statement: The proposal is an open-source concept submission and not a qualification-stage legal tender document.
risk: Formal tender eligibility and seal requirements are outside agent scope.
mitigation: Provide editable structured files and a copyright statement for team review.
